eli: CI alert: SAST job 204 failed to upload scan report. Error: KMS decrypt denied for key security/scan-reports.

maya: Who changed keystore bindings? I see PR #518 modified keystore-policy.yaml.

frank: That was my PR. I scoped bindings for cleanup. Looks like I dropped the scanner SA. Reverting now.

eli: Pipeline log snippet: error: google.kms.v1.Decrypt PermissionDenied caller=serviceAccount:scan-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-810 created.

maya: Quick mitigation: grant temporary binding and restart CI. We should also add a premerge smoke test to validate key permissions.

frank: Reverted in PR #518 and restarted pipeline. Build 205 passed. Opening SEC-701 for premerge keystore checks and a GitHub Action that tags keystore changes with required SEC ticket.

eli: Please add runbook snippet for emergency rebind commands and an automated audit-log query. Example: gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding scan-reports --member=serviceAccount:scan-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter

sec-bot: INC-2026-810 closed by frank (mitigated).
